hooks.note: PC-relative literal LDR.W sb at +6: trampoline must relocate it, not blindly copy.
Primary router captures the private child before stock fixed-page dispatch.

bindings.note: 100 32-bit native top-window slots; own child is removed before destroy.

external_imports: Resolve libc, CTK/GTK and g_timeout_add/gtk_signal_connect exports through target module dynamic symbols. No loader-side call to GTK or payload init is permitted.
lifecycle: Owner destroy signal closes child on UI thread; media-kind/media-number/deck-mode or page changes close it; Return restores root focus; OPTIONS closes child and delegates stock exit. One process-lifetime GLib timer runs on the same UI main loop.
